cost.scope: Blender render timers only; excludes orchestration, I/O and compositing overhead

nonClaims: This derivation cannot confirm temporal quality because its observations may be used to freeze a later threshold.
The dual REFERENCE1024 mean is a reference proxy, not ground truth.
Temporal error-delta ratios are not calibrated visibility or cinematic-quality scores.
Motion blur is disabled and the eight-frame interval is one scene on one machine.
A later formal holdout must use a disjoint consecutive-frame interval and entirely new outputs.
Human preference and visible flicker require an independently completed blind review.
